description: Source code for managing pack geometry in a Git repository, including functions for initializing, splitting, selecting preferred packs, removing redundant packs, and releasing resources related to pack files.

methods.name: pack_geometry_weight
methods.description: Calculates the weight (size) of a pack based on the number of objects after opening its index.

methods.name: pack_geometry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting packs by their weight.

methods.name: pack_geometry_init
methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry structure by collecting relevant pack files based on criteria.

methods.name: compute_pack_geometry_split
methods.description: Determines the split point in a list of packs based on geometric progression and size thresholds.

methods.name: pack_geometry_split
methods.description: Computes and updates the split points for pack and promisor pack lists.

methods.name: pack_geometry_preferred_pack
methods.description: Selects the preferred pack for repacking based on the current geometry.

methods.name: remove_redundant_packs
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files that are not needed anymore.

methods.name: pack_geometry_remove_redundant
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the geometry's pack lists.

methods.name: pack_geometry_release
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for pack geometry.
